create_env_with_wrapper: create a gym environment using make_env_func that wraps non-multiagent envs with MultiAgentWrapper and DictObservationsWrapper
iterate_nested_dict: iterate recursively through a nested dictionary yielding leaf key-value pairs with iterate_recursively
copy_dict_structure: copy the structure of a nested dictionary without values using copy_dict_structure populated with Nones
batch_tensors_from_arrays: batch numpy arrays into PyTorch tensors using TensorBatcher.cat with optional pinned memory and object pooling
manage_gpu_allocation: set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES for a process using set_gpus_for_process to allocate GPUs across multiple processes
